{{Header Nav|game=Assassin's Creed II}}

There are 6 Lairs, spread across Italy, all of which, upon completion, reward you with a Seal, which can be used to unlock Altair's Armour. All the tomb missions are optional except Novella's Secret which is used to progress the story (Sequence 4).

==Novella's Secret==
*'''Location''': Florence
*'''Reward''': 1,250ƒ, Seal of Darius

==Il Duomo's Secret==
*'''Location''': Florence, Basilica Santa Maria del Fiore (North End)
*'''Reward''': 1,250ƒ, Seal of Iltani

==Torre Grossa's Secret==
*'''Location''': Tuscany, Torre Grossa
*'''Reward''': 1,250ƒ, Seal of Wei Yu

==Ravaldino's Secret==
*'''Location''': Forli
*'''Reward''': 1,250ƒ, Seal of Qulan

==Visitazone's Secret==
*'''Location''': Venice
*'''Reward''': 1,250ƒ, Seal of Leonius

==San Marco's Secret==
*'''Location''': Venice
*'''Reward''': 1,250ƒ, Seal of Amunet
